$comment: Generated from packages/config/src/schema by `npm run env:example`. Do not edit.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL
vars.doc: Convex deployment URL (worker, web, scripts).

vars.name: CONVEX_URL
vars.doc: Legacy alias of NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL.

vars.name: CONVEX_SERVICE_TOKEN
vars.doc: Shared service token; must be equal in the worker, Convex and the web server.

vars.name: CONVEX_SITE_URL
vars.doc: Convex HTTP actions URL; a Convex system var, derived from NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL on the web side.

vars.name: PROVIDER_ENCRYPTION_KEY
vars.doc: AES-256-GCM key (base64, 32 bytes) for stored provider credentials; worker and Convex must match.

vars.name: PROVIDER_ENCRYPTION_KEY_OLD
vars.doc: Previous encryption key, tried during a key rotation (Convex only today).

vars.name: LLM_PROVIDER
vars.doc: Global LLM provider fallback: anthropic | openai | openai-compatible.

vars.name: LLM_MODEL
vars.doc: Global fallback model; the default depends on LLM_PROVIDER.

vars.name: LLM_BASE_URL
vars.doc: Global fallback base URL; the default depends on LLM_PROVIDER.

vars.name: LLM_OPENAI_BASE_URL
vars.doc: OpenAI-flavour base URL (Convex only).

vars.name: LLM_ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
vars.doc: Anthropic-flavour base URL (Convex only).

vars.name: LLM_API_KEY
vars.doc: Global fallback API key; also the default apiKeyEnv name.

vars.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
vars.doc: Legacy fallback for LLM_API_KEY.

vars.name: LLM_ROUND_ROBIN_STICKY_LIMIT
vars.doc: How many calls in a row one provider serves before the round robin moves on.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_LLM_MAX_TOKENS
vars.doc: Max output tokens per LLM call.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_LLM_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.doc: Ceiling for one LLM request (ms).

vars.name: STAGEHAND_API_KEY
vars.doc: Operator override for the Stagehand browser tool's model key.

vars.name: STAGEHAND_MODEL
vars.doc: Operator override for the Stagehand browser tool's model.

vars.name: GITHUB_CLIENT_ID
vars.doc: GitHub OAuth app client id.

vars.name: GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET
vars.doc: GitHub OAuth app client secret.

vars.name: GITHUB_OAUTH_CALLBACK_URL
vars.doc: OAuth callback URL (default http://localhost:3000/api/integrations/github/callback).

vars.name: GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
vars.doc: Fallback webhook secret; without one webhooks answer 401.

vars.name: OAUTH_STATE_SECRET
vars.doc: HMAC secret for OAuth state; falls back to PROVIDER_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

vars.name: APP_ORIGIN
vars.doc: Web app origin; defaults to the origin of GITHUB_OAUTH_CALLBACK_URL.

vars.name: MOAGENT_WEEKLY_TOKEN_BUDGET
vars.doc: Weekly token budget for the usage meter; unset = meter off.

vars.name: FHARA_HOST
vars.doc: Host the Next launcher binds (scripts/next.mjs).

vars.name: FHARA_ALLOWED_HOSTS
vars.doc: Extra Host headers the API guard accepts (comma-separated).

vars.name: FHARA_ALLOW_LOCAL_MCP
vars.doc: 1 lets the web API register local (stdio) MCP servers.

vars.name: FHARA_BIND_TAILSCALE
vars.doc: 1 also binds the dev server to this machine's Tailscale address.

vars.name: WORKER_POLL_INTERVAL_MS
vars.doc: Worker poll interval (ms).

vars.name: WORKER_FALLBACK_POLL_MS
vars.doc: Fallback poll while the pendingWork subscription is live (ms; never below the poll interval).

vars.name: WORKER_HEARTBEAT_MS
vars.doc: Worker heartbeat interval (ms).

vars.name: WORKER_LEASE_MS
vars.doc: Task lease length (ms).

vars.name: WORKER_CONCURRENCY
vars.doc: Tasks one worker runs at once.

vars.name: WORKER_STALE_GRACE_MS
vars.doc: Grace before a lease-less running task counts as stale (ms).

vars.name: WORKER_PUSH_POLL_MS
vars.doc: How often an idle worker checks for approved push requests (ms).

vars.name: WORKER_MCP_TEST_POLL_MS
vars.doc: How often an idle worker checks for MCP Test connection requests (ms).

vars.name: WORKER_REPO_TOOL_POLL_MS
vars.doc: Idle poll for grounded chat repo-tool requests (ms).

vars.name: WORKER_OPENCODE_CATALOG_POLL_MS
vars.doc: How often the worker checks whether the OpenCode model catalog needs a refresh (ms).

vars.name: WORKER_ID
vars.doc: Worker id; defaults to <hostname>-<pid> (supplied by the worker).

vars.name: WORKER_SUBSCRIBE
vars.doc: 0 turns off the websocket wake-up subscription (poll only).

vars.name: WORKER_LLM_MAX_CONCURRENCY
vars.doc: Worker-wide LLM gate; falls back to ORCHESTRATOR_MAX_CONCURRENT_LLM_CALLS, then 1.

vars.name: FHARA_MEMORY_SUGGESTIONS
vars.doc: 0 turns off memory suggestions after a task.

vars.name: FHARA_ROLE_MEMORY
vars.doc: 0 turns off role memory (per-role learnings) for every project.

vars.name: DIRECT_POLL_MS
vars.doc: Direct-thread poll interval (ms).

vars.name: DIRECT_IDLE_MIN
vars.doc: Minutes before an idle direct thread is closed.

vars.name: DIRECT_MAX_LIVE
vars.doc: Max live direct threads per worker (1–8).

vars.name: DIRECT_ENGINE
vars.doc: api-loop forces the API loop engine; auto prefers OpenCode ACP.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_MAX_REPLANS
vars.doc: Max replans per task (0–3).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_WORKTREE_ISOLATION
vars.doc: Run each task in its own git worktree.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_PARALLEL_DEFAULT
vars.doc: Default parallel DAG nodes when worktree isolation is on (1–3).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_MAX_SUBTASKS
vars.doc: Max subtasks per plan (1–20).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_MAX_CONCURRENCY
vars.doc: Max subtasks running at once (1–8); defaults to the parallel default.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_MAX_PLANNING_ITERATIONS
vars.doc: Planning iteration bound (0–3); defaults to ORCHESTRATOR_MAX_REPLANS.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_MAX_REVIEW_ITERATIONS
vars.doc: Max review fix rounds (0–5).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_SUBTASK_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.doc: Subtask timeout (ms); when set explicitly the runner does not grow it from observed latency.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_SUBTASK_TIMEOUT_HIGH_MS
vars.doc: Subtask timeout for high/ultra complexity tasks (ms); default max(900000, ORCHESTRATOR_SUBTASK_TIMEOUT_MS).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_SUBTASK_RETRIES
vars.doc: Retries per failed subtask (0–3).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.doc: How long a pending approval waits (ms).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.doc: Live task deadline (ms).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_TASK_TIMEOUT_HIGH_MS
vars.doc: Task deadline for high/ultra complexity tasks (ms); default max(2400000, ORCHESTRATOR_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.doc: Abort a task after this long without observable progress (ms).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_PLANNING_STALL_MS
vars.doc: Planner-call stall watchdog (ms, 0 = off).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_VERIFICATION_ENABLED
vars.doc: Run verification after code changes.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_VERIFICATION_BUILD
vars.doc: Include the build in verification.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_VERIFICATION_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.doc: Verification timeout (ms; can only be lowered).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_MAX_AGENTS_PER_TASK
vars.doc: Max agents per task (1–10).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_MAX_LLM_CALLS_PER_TASK
vars.doc: LLM call budget per task (1–1000).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_MAX_DELEGATION_DEPTH
vars.doc: Max delegation chain depth (0–10).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_MAX_DELEGATIONS
vars.doc: Max approved delegations per task (0–100).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_BUDGET_MODE
vars.doc: Budget exhaustion: warn (default) or enforce.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_MAX_CONCURRENT_LLM_CALLS
vars.doc: Per-task LLM gate (1–8); defaults to the parallel default.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_MAX_TOKEN_BUDGET_PER_TASK
vars.doc: Token budget per task.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_ALLOW_FALLBACK
vars.doc: Let routing fall back to the top agent when no agent serves a capability.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_AUTHORITATIVE
vars.doc: The orchestrator's plan and decisions are the ones executed.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_ROUTER_LLM
vars.doc: When the intent router consults the LLM advisor.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_CHAT_MAX_AGENTS
vars.doc: Max agents answering one chat message (1–5).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_DECISION_LLM
vars.doc: When the decision engine consults the LLM advisor.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_MAX_DECISION_STEPS
vars.doc: Max decision steps per task run (1–200).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_TOOL_LOOP
vars.doc: Labs: dynamic tool discovery for research/audit agents.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_MCP_TOOL_LOOP
vars.doc: Read-only agents may use discovered MCP tools mid-task.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_MCP_WRITE_TOOLS
vars.doc: Allow MCP write tools (otherwise filtered for every role).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_MCP_MAX_TOOL_ITERATIONS
vars.doc: MCP tool-loop rounds per subtask (1–20).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.doc: Per-MCP-request timeout (ms).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_MCP_MAX_RESULT_CHARS
vars.doc: Cap on one MCP tool result (chars).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_AGENT_REACH_ENABLED
vars.doc: Agent Reach web tool for agents that declare web_reach.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_AGENT_REACH_COMMAND
vars.doc: Agent Reach binary.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_AGENT_REACH_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.doc: Wall-clock limit per Agent Reach call (ms).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_AGENT_REACH_MAX_ITEMS
vars.doc: Items one Agent Reach call returns (1–20).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_AGENT_REACH_MAX_TOOL_ITERATIONS
vars.doc: Agent Reach tool-loop rounds (1–20).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_REVIEW_MODE
vars.doc: When a review node is added for a code change.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_QA_MODE
vars.doc: When a browser QA node is added for a code change.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_QA_MAX_FIX_ITERATIONS
vars.doc: Max automatic QA fix rounds (0–5); falls back to the legacy QA_MAX_FIX_ITERATIONS.

vars.name: QA_MAX_FIX_ITERATIONS
vars.doc: Legacy name of ORCHESTRATOR_QA_MAX_FIX_ITERATIONS.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_QA_REQUIRED
vars.doc: An environment-blocked QA run fails the task; falls back to the legacy QA_REQUIRED.

vars.name: QA_REQUIRED
vars.doc: Legacy name of ORCHESTRATOR_QA_REQUIRED.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_LOAD_AWARE_ROUTING
vars.doc: Load-aware routing default when the project has none.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_PERFORMANCE_ROUTING
vars.doc: Performance routing default when the project has none.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_EXECUTION_RUNTIME
vars.doc: Global execution runtime: api (default) or native-provider (alias opencode).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_RUNTIME
vars.doc: Legacy name of ORCHESTRATOR_EXECUTION_RUNTIME.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_NATIVE_PROVIDER_COMMAND
vars.doc: OpenCode (native provider) binary.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_NATIVE_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.doc: Wall-clock limit for one OpenCode run (ms).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_OPENCODE_ALLOW_UNISOLATED
vars.doc: 1 lets OpenCode run in the project checkout without worktree isolation.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_COMMAND_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.doc: How long a pending command approval waits before it counts as declined (ms, ≥ 10000).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.doc: Agent stall window (ms, 0 = off); default is the LLM timeout plus a minute.

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_STALL_RETRIES
vars.doc: Retries after a stall (0–3).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_REPEAT_OUTPUT_LIMIT
vars.doc: Identical consecutive outputs that stop a fix loop (2–10).

vars.name: ORCHESTRATOR_VERIFY_BASELINE
vars.doc: 0 turns off the verification baseline run (heuristic only).

vars.name: REPO_MAP
vars.doc: 0 turns off the repo map in agent prompts.

vars.name: REPO_MAP_MAX_CHARS
vars.doc: Repo map budget (chars, ≥ 200).

vars.name: FHARA_CACHE_DIR
vars.doc: Repo map cache directory (default ~/.fhara/cache).

vars.name: FHARA_OPENCODE_CACHE_DIR
vars.doc: Persistent OpenCode cache (default <tmp>/fhara-opencode-cache).

vars.name: FHARA_COMMIT_MESSAGE_LLM
vars.doc: 0 turns off LLM-written commit messages.

vars.name: FHARA_OPENCODE_VERIFY_POLICY
vars.doc: 0 turns off the OpenCode permission-policy check before a run.

vars.name: FHARA_CHILD_ENV_PASSTHROUGH
vars.doc: Extra parent env names forwarded to spawned processes (comma-separated).

vars.name: FHARA_GIT_AUTHOR_NAME
vars.doc: Commit author name.

vars.name: FHARA_GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL
vars.doc: Commit author email.

vars.name: FHARA_ALLOW_FORCE_PUSH
vars.doc: Allow force pushes from agent tools.

vars.name: FHARA_ALLOW_BASE_BRANCH_PUSH
vars.doc: Allow pushes to the base branch from agent tools.

vars.name: FHARA_PR_DRAFT
vars.doc: Open pull requests as drafts.

vars.name: FHARA_PR_FIX_MAX_ATTEMPTS
vars.doc: Automatic PR-feedback fix attempts (0–20).

vars.name: FHARA_AUTO_MERGE_MAX_LINES
vars.doc: Supervised auto-merge: max diff lines.

vars.name: FHARA_AUTO_MERGE_SENSITIVE
vars.doc: Supervised auto-merge: globs that always need a human (comma-separated).

vars.name: FHARA_AUTO_MERGE_METHOD
vars.doc: Supervised auto-merge method.

vars.name: FHARA_WORKTREE_RETENTION_HOURS
vars.doc: Hours a finished task's worktree is kept.

vars.name: QA_BASE_URL
vars.doc: Fallback QA target URL for projects without a QA/dev URL.

vars.name: QA_CHROMIUM_PATH
vars.doc: Chromium binary for browser QA (falls back to PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH, then Playwright's own).

vars.name: QA_CHROMIUM_NO_SANDBOX
vars.doc: Chromium --no-sandbox: unset = auto (root or container), 0/false = off, anything else = on.

vars.name: QA_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.doc: How long QA waits for the dev server (ms).

vars.name: QA_SERVER_START_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.doc: Legacy name of QA_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS.

vars.name: CONTEXT_SNAPSHOTS
vars.doc: 0 turns off context snapshots.

vars.name: FHARA_SNAPSHOT_RETENTION_DAYS
vars.doc: Days a context snapshot is kept.

vars.name: CHAT_REPLY_STALE_MS
vars.doc: When an unfinished chat reply counts as stale (ms, at least 11 min).

vars.name: TASK_WATCHDOG_STUCK_MS
vars.doc: When a running task without progress counts as stuck (ms, 0 = off).

vars.name: WORKSPACE_ROOT
vars.doc: Where project workspaces live (relative to the worker's cwd).

vars.name: DEV_SERVER_URL
vars.doc: URL the Electron shell loads.

vars.name: SUPERVISE_MAX_RESTARTS
vars.doc: Restart cap for scripts/supervise.mjs (default unlimited).

vars.name: SUPERVISE_GRACE_MS
vars.doc: Grace period before supervise.mjs kills a child (ms).

vars.name: FHARA_SMOKE_REPO
vars.doc: owner/repo for npm run smoke:push.

vars.name: FHARA_SMOKE_PROXY_AUTH
vars.doc: 1 tests the push through an authenticating proxy (smoke:push).

vars.name: FHARA_SMOKE_GITHUB_TOKEN
vars.doc: Token for smoke:push; falls back to GITHUB_TOKEN, then GH_TOKEN.

vars.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
vars.doc: GitHub token for build-skill-catalog and smoke:push (never forwarded to children by default).

vars.name: GH_TOKEN
vars.doc: gh CLI token; smoke:push fallback.
